mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_mapper (revision_id, mapper_type, namespace, statement_id, statement_type, parameter_type, result_type, sql_body, file_id, line_start, line_end) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{mapperType}, #{namespace}, #{statementId}, #{statementType}, #{parameterType}, #{resultType}, #{sqlBody} , #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{lineEnd, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_config (revision_id, key_path, value, value_type, placeholder, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{keyPath}, #{value}, #{valueType}, #{placeholder}, #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_resource (revision_id, resource_type, name, location, value, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{resourceType}, #{name}, #{location}, #{value}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_mapper SET method_id = NULL WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND method_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT mapper_id AS "mapperId" , namespace AS "namespace" , statement_id AS "statementId" , statement_type AS "statementType" FROM analysis_mapper WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY mapper_id

SELECT mapper_id AS "mapperId" , namespace AS "namespace" , statement_id AS "statementId" , statement_type AS "statementType" , sql_body AS "sqlBody" , file_id AS "fileId" , line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_mapper WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' AND mapper_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY mapper_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT sql_body FROM analysis_mapper WHERE mapper_id = #{mapperId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT m.revision_id, 'METHOD', jm.method_id, 'EXECUTES_SQL', 'SQL', 'S' || m.mapper_id, 'HIGH', 'RESOLVED' , jsonb_build_object('via', 'MAPPER_INTERFACE'), jm.file_id, jm.line_start FROM analysis_mapper m JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.fqn = m.namespace AND s.kind = 'INTERFACE' JOIN analysis_method jm ON jm.revision_id = s.revision_id AND jm.owner_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND jm.name = m.statement_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT'
mapper.select: SELECT r.reference_id AS "referenceId" , r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.name AS "name" , r.arg_text AS "argText" , r.file_id AS "fileId" , r.line_start AS "lineStart" , m.owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = r.revision_id AND m.method_id = r.from_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.ref_kind = 'CALL' AND r.from_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.arg_text IS NOT NULL AND r.reference_id > #{afterId} AND r.name IN #{name} ORDER BY r.reference_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, to_external , confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{fromKind}, #{fromId}, #{relationType}, #{toKind}, #{toId}, #{toExternal} , #{confidence}, #{resolutionStatus}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_mapper m SET method_id = x.method_id FROM (SELECT r.to_id, MIN(r.from_id) AS method_id FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.to_id) x WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND x.to_id = 'S' || m.mapper_id
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE chain (symbol_id, depth) AS ( SELECT CAST(#{symbolId} AS varchar), 0 UNION SELECT r.to_id, c.depth + 1 FROM chain c JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = c.symbol_id AND r.relation_type = 'EXTENDS' AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL WHERE c.depth < 20 ) SELECT symbol_id FROM chain GROUP BY symbol_id ORDER BY MIN(depth)

SELECT 'MAPPER:' || mapper_type || ':' || statement_type AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_mapper WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY mapper_type, statement_type UNION ALL SELECT 'CONFIG', COUNT(*) FROM analysis_config WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'RESOURCE:' || resource_type, COUNT(*) FROM analysis_resource WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY resource_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.to_external AS "table" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.relation_type = 'READS_TABLE') AS "reads" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.properties_json->>'crud' = 'C') AS "inserts" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.properties_json->>'crud' = 'U') AS "updates" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.properties_json->>'crud' = 'D') AS "deletes" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') AND r.to_external LIKE '%' || upper(#{name}) || '%' GROUP BY r.to_external ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, r.to_external LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.properties_json->>'crud' AS "crud" , t.confidence AS "confidence" , COALESCE(m.namespace || '.', '') || m.statement_id AS "statement" , m.statement_type AS "statementType" , f.path AS "mapperFile" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" , e.from_id AS "methodId" , s.fqn || '#' || jm.signature AS "method" FROM analysis_relation t JOIN analysis_mapper m ON m.revision_id = t.revision_id AND 'S' || m.mapper_id = t.from_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id LEFT JOIN analysis_relation e ON e.revision_id = t.revision_id AND e.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND e.to_id = t.from_id LEFT JOIN analysis_method jm ON jm.revision_id = e.revision_id AND jm.method_id = e.from_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = jm.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = jm.owner_symbol_id WHERE t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') AND t.to_external = upper(#{table}) ORDER BY t.properties_json->>'crud', m.namespace, m.statement_id, s.fqn LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' AND m.namespace LIKE '%' || #{namespace} || '%' AND m.statement_id LIKE '%' || #{statementId} || '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT m.mapper_id AS "mapperId" , m.mapper_type AS "mapperType" , m.namespace AS "namespace" , m.statement_id AS "statementId" , m.statement_type AS "statementType" , m.parameter_type AS "parameterType" , m.result_type AS "resultType" , f.path AS "file" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" , (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT t.to_external || '(' || (t.properties_json->>'crud') || ')', ', ') FROM analysis_relation t WHERE t.revision_id = m.revision_id AND t.from_id = 'S' || m.mapper_id AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')) AS "tables" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_relation e WHERE e.revision_id = m.revision_id AND e.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND e.to_id = 'S' || m.mapper_id) AS "callers" FROM analysis_mapper m JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id
ORDER BY m.namespace, m.statement_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.key_path AS "key", c.value AS "value", c.value_type AS "valueType", c.placeholder AS "placeholder" , f.path AS "file", c.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_config c JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = c.file_id WHERE c.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND c.key_path LIKE '%' || #{key} || '%' ORDER BY f.path, c.config_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
